title: The Fairy Pools
subtitle: A light goes missing
opening: Liza, your wand has woken the castle gate. Beyond it, the fairies are all sick. Something is poisoning the water.
ending: Three pools sparkle again. The fairies can fly, but their Heart Crystal is still missing. A warm silver scale points toward the Crystal Caves.
not_yet: That place is resting. Follow the glowing landmark on your quest card.

steps.title: A whisper beyond the castle
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Liza! I am Luma, keeper of the Fairy Pools. Our water has turned dark. Find three little lights around the house, then come back to me at the TV.

steps.title: Three little lights
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Visit all three landmarks. Find a Moon Dewdrop at the Moon Crystal, a Silverleaf at the Elder Tree, and a Sunbell at the Treasure Chest.

steps.title: The Glowmend spell
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: You brought them! Moonlight, leaflight, sunlight: join together. This is Glowmend. It repairs what is hurt. Come close and learn its sign.

steps.title: Wake the three pools
steps.clue: Carry Glowmend from the Moon Crystal to the Elder Tree, then to the Treasure Chest. Each wave clears one pool. Take your time; the fairies will wait.
steps.speaker: Luma

steps.title: The empty cradle
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: The fairies are opening their wings! But look beneath the water. The cradle for the Heart Crystal is empty. The pools need that crystal to stay well.

steps.title: A bent fern
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Go to the Elder Tree. A fern has been bent by tiny muddy boots. Wave to uncover the trail.

steps.title: A knot of blue ribbon
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Search the Treasure Chest. Someone dropped a blue ribbon with a tiny bell. Let your wand lift it.

steps.title: The warm silver scale
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Visit the Moon Crystal. A silver scale is caught in a crack. It feels warm, even in this cold water. Wave to collect it.

steps.title: A trail into the mountain
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Tiny boots. A blue ribbon. A warm scale. Someone carried our crystal into the Crystal Caves. You made the fairies well enough to follow. Meet me at the realm map.
